children: K&F Growth Acquisition II entered into two unsecured, non-interest-bearing promissory notes totaling $600,000 with sponsors Daniel Fetters and Edward King to fund working capital needs while pursuing a business combination. Each $300,000 note matures at the earlier of the SPAC’s initial business combination or its liquidation, and if no deal closes, repayment will come only from funds outside the trust. Prior to a business combination, each payee may elect to convert principal into units identical to those sold in the IPO private placement, consisting of one Class A share and a right to receive one-fifteenth of a Class A share upon deal closing.
